title: Fix skill slop before it makes your AI workforce worse
summary: Great skills and agent instructions are like giving superpowers to AI, but unmaintained skills actually make your agents worse.
body_markdown:
About the author


Prithvi Ramakrishnan , Co-founder


Prithvi co-founded Promptless. Before Promptless, he served as VP of Product & Engineering at Bond, a fintech infrastructure startup acquired by FIS in 2023. There he saw firsthand the effort required to maintain hundreds of tutorials and guides and the outsized business impact of world-class documentation. Prithvi graduated from Stanford in 2015 (B.S. CS, AI track).
